#2395. "Il n’y a personne à qui tu ne plais pas, Gaël" : les messages touchants de Rafael Nadal et Novak Djokovic pour les adieux de Gaël Monfils

Mardi soir, Gaël Monfils a fait ses adieux au tennis professionnel au Rolex Paris Masters. Pour saluer le départ du joueur français, Rafael Nadal et Novak Djokovic lui ont notamment chacun adressé un message vidéo, diffusé sur les écrans géants du court central.

Organisée le mardi 3 novembre 2026 en session de soirée, cette célébration s'est tenue sur le court central de la Plénitude Arena de Nanterre, après la victoire de l'Américain Ben Shelton face à Cameron Norrie et avant le duel opposant Casper Ruud à Rafael Jódar. Âgé de 40 ans, Gaël Monfils avait officialisé sa retraite le mois dernier.

Diffusé sur les écrans géants lors de cet hommage, le message vidéo de Rafael Nadal a particulièrement marqué les esprits. L'Espagnol s'est remémoré leur jeunesse commune et la longévité exceptionnelle de leurs parcours respectifs sur le circuit. En utilisant délibérément le pronom « nous », le Majorquin a ainsi associé sa propre trajectoire à celle de Gaël Monfils après plus de vingt ans passés à se côtoyer au plus haut niveau. Un clin d'œil appuyé à leur route partagée depuis les tournois juniors.

Rafael Nadal n'était d'ailleurs pas le seul cador à honorer Gaël Monfils lors de cette soirée à la Plénitude Arena de Nanterre. La vidéo projetée sur le court central comprenait également des messages signés Roger Federer et Novak Djokovic. Dans son intervention, le joueur serbe a notamment salué la personnalité du joueur français dans les vestiaires.

Au cours de ses 22 années de carrière sur le circuit ATP, conclues avec un sommet au 6e rang mondial et 13 titres conquis, Gaël Monfils a pu mesurer une dernière fois l'attachement des supporters. Sur le court, il a effectué un tour d'honneur aux côtés de Gilles Moretton, président de la FFT, et de Cédric Pioline, directeur du tournoi, avant d'être rejoint par Jo-Wilfried Tsonga, Richard Gasquet et Gilles Simon. Le Tricolore a ensuite pris la parole pour remercier chaleureusement le public français, ses parents et sa fille Skai, âgée de quatre ans.

Après cet hommage, le Rolex Paris Masters se poursuit ce mercredi 4 novembre 2026 avec les rencontres du deuxième tour, dont le match programmé entre Arthur Fils et Tomáš Macháč.

#2394. INTERVIEW: Bayern icon Makaay critiques Yamal and Mbappe's efforts to deny Kane of "deserved" Ballon d'Or

MÜNCHEN (Bulinews): Bayern Munich legend Roy Makaay feels Harry Kane not only richly deserved his Ballon d'Or award, but conducted himself with class compared with some of his closer competitors' campaigns in the race for football's top individual accolade.

“I think this year compared to other years there were quite a lot of candidates to win the Ballon d’Or. What I liked is that the one [Kane] who won didn’t advertise for themselves,” the Dutch striker said at a media round attended by Bulinews.com.

“The other two [Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappé] were just speaking at press conferences that they should win it. In the end, it’s the journalists who decide who wins it and that’s the way it should be.

“You shouldn’t depend on making advertisements like Yamal and Mbappé. I mean, they are all amazing players, I like watching them both but I think [the Ballon d’Or winner] is up to the voters.

“I think [Kane’s action in the build up] was the best approach. It was really nice to see him win it and in my eyes he deserved it. If you score 73 goals, win the [German] double and get third-place at the World Cup [with England]

“It shows he deserved it. I think it’s nice not only for Bayern but also the Bundesliga to say we have the Ballon d’Or [winner] in our league,” explained the marksman who played over 183 games for the Bavarian giants between 2003-07.

#2393. « Cela m’a vraiment remué, choqué et ému » : Patrick Battiston confie sa vive émotion après la disparition de Jesús de Miguel

Le monde du football est sous le choc après le décès tragique de l'attaquant espagnol Jesús de Miguel. Très touché par ce drame survenu sur les pelouses espagnoles, l'ancien international tricolore Patrick Battiston est sorti du silence pour livrer son émotion.

Ce mardi 3 novembre 2026, le CD Tenerife a officialisé la disparition de son joueur de 30 ans, mort à 8h00 à l'hôpital universitaire Nuestra Señora de Candelaria à Santa Cruz de Tenerife. La veille, le lundi 2 novembre, lors de la 12e journée de Liga 2 contre le FC Andorre (2-2) au stade Heliodoro Rodríguez López,  Jesús de Miguel avait été violemment heurté au niveau du thorax en toute fin de match par le gardien de l'équipe adverse, sorti en dehors de sa surface.

Profondément touché par la nouvelle, Patrick Battiston a confié au quotidien L'Équipe avoir été bouleversé en apprenant ce drame. « Je suis allé marcher et cela m’a fortement interpellé, confie l'ancien défenseur tricolore, aujourd'hui âgé de 69 ans. En me promenant, je n’avais que ça en tête. Quand je suis rentré à la maison, j’ai voulu regarder ce qui s’était passé et en fait, je n’ai pas trop vu les images. Du peu que j’en ai vu, elles sont horribles. C’est quelque chose de dur et de violent. Cela m’a vraiment remué, choqué et ému. Surtout de voir ses équipiers et ses adversaires se prendre la tête entre les mains. Ce qui s’est passé est terrible. »

Cet accident a immédiatement rappelé à Patrick Battiston le violent choc dont il avait été victime le 8 juillet 1982 à Séville, lors de la demi-finale de Coupe du monde face à l'Allemagne de l'Ouest. Ce jour-là, le gardien ouest-allemand Harald Schumacher avait percuté de plein fouet l'international français. Un souvenir glaçant. L'ancien défenseur s'est souvenu qu'après la collision, le médecin des Bleus Maurice Vrillac avait cru à son décès sur le terrain.

« Après coup, je me suis dit : il me semble que le docteur Maurice Vrillac croyait que j’étais mort. Cela n’a heureusement pas été le cas pour moi, même s’il s’avère que j’ai eu des choses qui ne se sont pas vues dans l’immédiat – car les scanners et IRM n’existaient pas encore il y a 45 ans –, et que j’en ai gardé des séquelles », a ainsi précisé Patrick Battiston dans les colonnes de L'Équipe.

Au-delà de l'émotion de Patrick Battiston, la disparition de Jesús de Miguel touche l'ensemble du football espagnol et européen. Après un arrêt cardiorespiratoire dans l'ambulance et une détérioration neurologique irréversible survenue durant la nuit, le joueur a succombé à ses blessures mardi matin. Face à cette situation tragique, la Fédération espagnole de football (RFEF) a suspendu et reporté plusieurs compétitions nationales, tandis que l'UEFA a ordonné une minute de silence sur toutes les pelouses européennes de la semaine.

Le club des îles Canaries tente de faire face au deuil après la perte de son attaquant de 30 ans. Le CD Tenerife a ainsi sollicité le report de ses deux prochaines rencontres de championnat, notamment le déplacement sur le terrain de Grenade programmé le samedi 7 novembre 2026.

#2392. « Cela aurait pu être ma fille » : Thierry Henry exprime sa profonde colère et son indignation sur le plateau de CBS

Sur le plateau de CBS Sports lors de la soirée de Ligue des champions ce mardi 3 novembre 2026, Thierry Henry a tenu à prendre la parole pour évoquer l'attentat raciste survenu dans les Yvelines. Un moment de grande émotion pour l'ancien attaquant des Bleus, profondément touché par ce drame.

Mardi soir, alors que les débats sportifs battaient leur plein autour des affiches européennes, Thierry Henry a choisi d'interrompre l'analyse pour aborder l'attentat raciste perpétré le 23 octobre 2026 à Trappes et La Verrière. Une prise de parole rare et solennelle en plein direct. L'ancien international français a livré un message sincère, visiblement ému par les événements survenus en région parisienne.

Son intervention a immédiatement été saluée sur le plateau de l'émission américaine. Ainsi, ses collègues consultants Jamie Carragher et Micah Richards ont salué ses propos par des applaudissements appuyés, marquant leur respect pour son engagement et sa dignité face à cette tragédie.

Au-delà de la compassion, Thierry Henry a insisté sur son histoire personnelle pour expliquer à quel point ce drame le touchait de près. Père de famille français, noir et originaire de la région parisienne, l'ex-buteur a partagé son sentiment de révolte et d'inquiétude pour les siens. « Je suis noir, je suis français, je suis père de famille. Cela aurait pu être mon frère, cela aurait pu être ma fille. Alors, cela doit cesser », a-t-il déclaré avec gravité face aux caméras.

L'ancien champion a également exprimé son incompréhension face aux remises en question de l'appartenance nationale. « À un moment donné, ça suffit. On se promène dans la rue et on se fait tuer, tout simplement. Est-ce que nous devons toujours prouver que nous sommes français ? Nous sommes français et cela ne changera jamais, quoi qu’il arrive », a poursuivi Thierry Henry sur le plateau de CBS Sports.

En effet, l'attaque survenue le 23 octobre 2026 à Trappes et La Verrière a fait un mort et sept blessés, dont une jeune fille de 12 ans. L'assaillant présumé, un homme de 39 ans, a été mis en examen et placé en détention provisoire après avoir reconnu avoir ciblé délibérément des personnes musulmanes, africaines ou nord-africaines. Un choc immense pour les familles.

Thierry Henry a tenu à honorer la mémoire de Pengo Bossio Wangi, combattant de MMA de 26 ans tué lors de cet attentat : « Je souhaite simplement rendre hommage et témoigner mon respect aux familles des victimes, et évidemment à la famille de Pengo, qui a perdu la vie simplement parce qu’il était noir. Je voulais simplement apporter un peu de soutien à toutes les personnes qui ont souffert de cet événement. Comme je l’ai dit, je vais me répéter : ça suffit ».

#2391. « Une décision inattendue, que l’OL regrette profondément » : Le communiqué amer de l'Olympique Lyonnais officialisant le départ de Paulo Fonseca

Ce mercredi 4 novembre 2026, l'Olympique Lyonnais a officialisé le départ de Paulo Fonseca de ses fonctions d'entraîneur de l'équipe professionnelle vers le Sporting Portugal. Dans un communiqué au ton particulièrement piquant, la direction rhodanienne a fustigé le timing de cette décision inattendue et l'engagement du technicien.

La nouvelle a surpris tout le monde à Lyon. Alors que son contrat avec l'OL courait initialement jusqu'au 30 juin 2027, Paulo Fonseca a lui-même informé ses dirigeants de sa volonté de partir. Le technicien de 53 ans a en effet été approché ces derniers jours par le Sporting Portugal, un club auquel il est particulièrement attaché. Pour racheter son contrat, la formation portugaise versera d'ailleurs une indemnité de 5 millions d'euros à l'OL. Toutefois, cette indemnité ne console pas les décideurs lyonnais.

Arrivé le 31 janvier 2025, Paulo Fonseca a dirigé son 83e et dernier match dimanche 1er novembre 2026 lors de la victoire contre Angers (2-0) au Groupama Stadium. Il quitte Lyon en laissant le club à la 3e place de Ligue 1 avec 17 points, pour un bilan de 5 victoires, 2 nuls et 2 défaites. Une dynamique sportive positive qui rend la séparation d'autant plus amère pour l'OL.

Au-delà de la surprise créée par cette demande, ce sont surtout les termes choisis par l'OL dans son communiqué qui détonnent. Loin des formules polies d'usage, l'état-major lyonnais a pointé du doigt l'attitude de son entraîneur. La direction a ainsi estimé qu'il « n'était pas dans l'intérêt du club de poursuivre une collaboration qui ne pouvait plus garantir le niveau d'engagement total indispensable à la réussite du projet ». Un reproche cinglant adressé au Portugais.

En effet, le club rhodanien a insisté sur le fait que dans « une période aussi déterminante de la saison », l'ensemble des forces devait être « entièrement mobilisé et concentré sur les objectifs ». Face à un entraîneur désireux d'ailleurs, l'OL a préféré trancher immédiatement dans le vif. La direction s'active désormais pour identifier un successeur au profil capable de s'inscrire dans la continuité du projet sportif et des principes développés ces derniers mois.

Dans l'immédiat, l'Olympique Lyonnais a dû réagir rapidement pour gérer le quotidien. C'est Jorge Maciel qui a été désigné pour assurer l'intérim à la tête de l'équipe professionnelle jusqu'à la prochaine trêve internationale de novembre 2026. Le technicien va devoir prendre le relais sans temps d'adaptation avant deux déplacements importants.

Jorge Maciel dirigera ainsi les Gones face à la Real Sociedad ce jeudi 5 novembre 2026 à 18h45 au stade d'Anoeta, dans le cadre de la Ligue Europa. Dans la foulée, le technicien conduira également le groupe lyonnais lors du déplacement en Ligue 1 à Brest, prévu le dimanche 8 novembre 2026 à 17h15.

#2390. « La vie ne se résume pas à gagner des courses cyclistes » : les confidences touchantes de Pauline Ferrand-Prévot après son année 2026 difficile

Pauline Ferrand-Prévot est sortie de plusieurs mois de silence pour évoquer ouvertement son état d'esprit et sa santé mentale. La leader de la formation Visma | Lease a Bike a pris la parole sur ses réseaux sociaux pour annoncer le terme d'une longue pause salutaire après son abandon lors du Tour de France Femmes.

Après une saison 2025 très réussie marquée par ses sacres sur Paris-Roubaix et la Grande Boucle, la championne rémoise de 34 ans a traversé un exercice 2026 bien plus contrasté, sans victoires majeures malgré des podiums sur le Tour des Flandres et Paris-Roubaix. En difficulté pour rivaliser avec les meilleures sur La Vuelta puis contrainte à l'abandon avant le départ de la 8e étape du Tour de France Femmes cet été selon les bilans de course, Pauline Ferrand-Prévot n'avait plus épinglé le moindre dossard en compétition depuis lors.

Éprouvée par cette spirale négative, Pauline Ferrand-Prévot a décidé de s'éloigner des pelotons pour faire redescendre une immense pression sportive. Sur son compte Instagram, la représentante de Visma | Lease a Bike a expliqué combien la quête absolue du résultat avait fini par étouffer son quotidien : « J’étais tellement focalisée sur l’idée de gagner à nouveau le Tour que j’en avais perdu la joie du quotidien. Tout tournait autour de la performance, de l’exigence constante de faire toujours plus pour être la meilleure. »

Face à une saison blanche de grands trophées en dépit d'une rigueur absolue, la championne a reconnu avoir été totalement surprise par cet échec sportif : « Par le passé, j’avais déjà traversé des périodes difficiles, où je me sentais triste et perdue. Mais je n’avais jamais vécu une situation où, malgré tous mes efforts et une préparation irréprochable, je me retrouvais finalement avec rien. C’est sans doute ce qui explique pourquoi, ces derniers mois, je n’arrivais tout simplement pas à comprendre ce qui m’arrivait. » Pour surmonter cette surcharge mentale, elle s'est donc accordé une vraie coupure en famille, loin des sacrifices habituels : « Depuis le Tour, j’ai parfois repris mon vélo, tout en m’accordant des plaisirs que je m’étais interdits durant toute la saison. J’ai passé du temps avec ma famille, profité des choses simples et savouré des moments précieux, loin du vélo. »

Au-delà de la sphère sportive, les récentes événements de sa vie personnelle ont profondément redéfini l'ordre de ses priorités. Le mercredi 7 octobre 2026, son compagnon Dylan van Baarle, qui court sous les couleurs de la formation Soudal Quick-Step, a été victime d'un accident de la circulation à l'entraînement ayant nécessité une intervention chirurgicale au poignet. Cet événement traumatisant a représenté un déclic majeur pour relativiser l'importance du sport de haut niveau dans son existence.

« Cet incident m’a fait prendre conscience que la vie ne se résume pas à gagner des courses cyclistes. Voir l’être que j’aime le plus au monde traverser une épreuve aussi douloureuse m’a permis de remettre les choses en perspective. Pour une fois, j’étais 'heureuse' de pouvoir être à ses côtés et de faire tout mon possible pour le soutenir. D’habitude, c’est toujours lui qui prend soin de moi », a détaillé la coureuse tricolore. Ainsi, le couple s'est marié fin octobre 2026 aux Pays-Bas au cours d'une cérémonie intime célébrée par la mère de Dylan van Baarle. « Je me souviens avoir ressenti beaucoup de joie en remportant les Jeux olympiques, le Tour ou Paris-Roubaix, mais épouser Dylan, entourée des personnes les plus importantes de ma vie, a procuré un bonheur et un épanouissement d’une tout autre dimension », a-t-elle confié sur le réseau social. Une étape fondamentale dans sa reconstruction.

Désormais apaisée, Pauline Ferrand-Prévot ne songe absolument pas à prendre sa retraite, elle dont le contrat avec la formation Visma | Lease a Bike court jusqu'à la fin de l'année 2028 selon des informations de presse. Toutefois, la coureuse ne compte brûler aucune étape avant d'envisager son grand retour à la compétition, constatant en toute lucidité la perte de sa condition physique : « Et voilà, c’est la fin d’une très longue intersaison, dont j’avais grand besoin. »

« Cette longue intersaison m’était vraiment nécessaire. Le chemin sera long pour retrouver un niveau correct, car je ne suis plus du tout en forme. Mais, pour l’instant, l’essentiel est de retrouver le plaisir d’être sur un vélo », a enchaîné la Rémoise. D'ailleurs, Pauline Ferrand-Prévot a d'ores et déjà fixé l'échéance de sa reprise de l'entraînement dès le mois de janvier afin de préparer la saison 2027. Un travail de longue haleine qu'elle aborde avec sérénité et une réelle envie : « Je suis sûre que je reviendrai plus forte. » Le premier coup de pédale est programmé pour janvier.

#2389. Emergenza Napoli, un azzurro espulso con la Juventus: salta la sfida contro la Lazio

Un calciatore del Napoli ha rimediato un cartellino rosso nel corso della gara contro la Juventus e dovrà saltare l'incontro con la Lazio

La sfida dell'Allianz Stadium contro la Juventus si è rivelata subito complicata per il Napoli, sceso in campo con una formazione dettata dall'emergenza. Tra i tanti infortuni e problemi fisici che hanno ridotto la rosa, il mister Massimiliano Allegri è stato costretto a ridisegnare il reparto arretrato lanciando dal primo minuto la coppia centrale formata da Marín e Marianucci.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

La partita del difensore azzurro si è purtroppo chiusa prima dello scadere dei 90 minuti a causa di un cartellino rosso. Già ammonito nel corso del primo tempo per un intervento falloso, infatti, Marianucci ha rimediato un secondo giallo al 75° minuto della ripresa a causa di uno step-on-foot. Un'espulsione inevitabile per il direttore di gara che ha lasciato il Napoli in inferiorità numerica proprio nel momento più delicato del match, subito dopo la rete dello svantaggio firmata da Alajbegović.

Oltre al danno immediato sul campo di Torino, il rosso rimediato costa caro a Marianucci anche in vista del prossimo turno di campionato. Il difensore salterà infatti per squalifica la prossima sfida che attende gli azzurri contro la Lazio, in programma l'8 novembre alle ore 12:30. Un'assenza pesante che obbliga lo staff tecnico a correre nuovamente ai ripari, costringendo il tecnico a studiare nuove soluzioni d'emergenza.

#2388. Une première pour un Français depuis 10 ans : Arthur Fils se qualifie pour les Finales ATP de Turin !

Ce mercredi 4 novembre 2026, Arthur Fils a validé mathématiquement sa qualification pour les Finales ATP de Turin, organisées du 15 au 22 novembre prochain. Le Français profite de l'exploit d'un autre Français, Quentin Halys, qui a éliminé Frances Tiafoe au Rolex Paris Masters.

Le dénouement s'est joué sur le court central de la Plénitude Arena à Nanterre. Opposé à l'Américain Frances Tiafoe, tête de série numéro 7 et 8e à la Race, Quentin Halys a signé une performance remarquable au deuxième tour du Rolex Paris Masters. Le 46e joueur mondial s'est imposé au terme d'un duel de 1 heure et 57 minutes (6-1, 3-6, 7-6 [9]). Frances Tiafoe servait pourtant pour le match à 5-4 dans la troisième manche, avant que Halys n'efface quatre balles de match dans le jeu décisif.

Un exploit retentissant. En se hissant en huitièmes de finale, Quentin Halys a précipité la fin des espoirs de l'Américain. En effet, ce revers de Frances Tiafoe valide définitivement la présence d'Arthur Fils à Turin parmi les huit meilleurs joueurs de la planète.

Cette qualification met fin à une longue attente pour le clan tricolore. Arthur Fils devient ainsi le premier joueur français à rallier les ATP Finals depuis Gaël Monfils en 2016. Une première depuis dix ans. À Turin, du 15 au 22 novembre 2026, il deviendra d'ailleurs le 10e joueur de l'histoire du tennis français à disputer ce prestigieux tournoi des maîtres de fin de saison.

La route menant Arthur Fils aux Finales ATP s'est révélée particulièrement atypique. En effet, le Français a manqué l'Open d'Australie et Roland-Garros en 2026 en raison de blessures, tout en restant discret à Wimbledon comme à l'US Open. Ainsi, il devient le premier joueur qualifié pour le Masters avec moins de deux matches gagnés en Grand Chelem sur une saison depuis Brad Gilbert en 1989.

Tête de série numéro 6, Arthur Fils dispute son deuxième tour du Rolex Paris Masters ce mercredi 4 novembre 2026 face à Tomas Machac, sur le court central, pas avant 20h30.

#2387. « J’ai accepté cette proposition avec beaucoup d’enthousiasme » : Rafael Nadal prend du galon au Real Madrid !

Le conseil d'administration du Real Madrid a officialisé ce mercredi 4 novembre 2026 la proposition d'intégrer Rafael Nadal au sein de son Conseil d’administration. Une arrivée majeure pour le club de la capitale et son président Florentino Pérez, qui doit désormais être soumise au vote des socios.

Réuni ce mercredi 4 novembre 2026, le conseil d'administration du Real Madrid a convenu de soumettre à l'assemblée générale des socios la ratification de la nomination de Rafael Nadal Parera comme nouveau membre de son Conseil d’administration. Cette proposition intervient en application de l'article 46 des statuts sociaux du club madrilène. Âgé de 40 ans et retraité des courts depuis 2024, le champion espagnol aux 22 tournois du Grand Chelem, dont un record de 14 victoires à Roland-Garros, franchit ainsi une étape institutionnelle majeure. Une figure emblématique du sport mondial au service du club de son cœur.

D'ailleurs, l'ancienne star du tennis n'arrive pas en terre inconnue dans la capitale espagnole, puisqu'il est socio d'honneur du Real Madrid et porte le numéro de socio 67 778. Dans un communiqué officiel publié ce mercredi 4 novembre 2026, l'institution madrilène a salué cette future arrivée : « Le Conseil d’administration du Real Madrid CF, réuni ce mercredi 4 novembre, a décidé de soumettre à l’Assemblée générale des membres délégués la ratification de la nomination de Rafael Nadal Parera, membre numéro 67 778 de notre club, en tant que nouveau membre du Conseil d’administration. Rafael Nadal, membre honoraire du Real Madrid, est l’une des plus grandes légendes de l’histoire du sport et l’un des athlètes espagnols les plus admirés et reconnus au monde. Pour le Real Madrid et pour tous les supporters madrilènes, c’est une grande fierté qu’une figure de son envergure sportive et humaine, une référence du sport espagnol et mondial, rejoigne notre conseil d’administration et contribue, depuis cette position à responsabilité, au présent et à l’avenir de notre club ».

Dans la foulée de cette annonce, Rafael Nadal a réagi publiquement sur ses réseaux sociaux pour partager son sentiment, en publiant une photo de lui enfant portant le maillot du Real Madrid et en remerciant le dirigeant merengue. « Je tiens à remercier le président Florentino Pérez et le conseil d’administration de m’avoir proposé de rejoindre le conseil d’administration du Real Madrid. J’ai accepté cette proposition avec beaucoup d’enthousiasme, l’envie d’apprendre et de m’investir autant que possible », a confié l'Espagnol.

Cet engagement clarifie la place de l'Espagnol au sein de la Maison Blanche. Plus tôt au cours de l'année 2026, Rafael Nadal avait déjà démenti sur ses réseaux sociaux les rumeurs l'associant à une éventuelle candidature à la présidence du club. Pas question de viser le sommet de l'organigramme pour l'instant. Il s'agit uniquement d'un rôle d'administrateur, où il entend apporter sa contribution au présent et au futur du Real Madrid.

Toutefois, l'intégration de la légende espagnole n'est pas encore définitivement actée. La ratification de sa nomination sera formellement soumise au vote des socios délégués lors d'une assemblée générale extraordinaire convoquée le samedi 21 novembre 2026. Cette réunion se tiendra au pavillon de basket de la Ciudad Real Madrid, immédiatement après l'assemblée générale ordinaire, avec pour unique point à l'ordre du jour la validation de l'entrée de Rafael Nadal.

Sur le plan sportif, le Real Madrid dispute ce mercredi 4 novembre 2026 à 18h45 un match contre l'AEK Athènes à l'Allwyn Arena pour la 4e journée de Ligue des champions. Les Madrilènes enchaîneront ensuite avec un déplacement en Liga contre le Valence CF à Mestalla, programmé le samedi 7 novembre 2026 à 21h00.

#2386. « Une immense tristesse » : Le FC Metz et le football français pleurent Carlo Molinari

Le FC Metz et le football français sont en deuil ce mercredi 4 novembre 2026. Le club mosellan a officialisé la disparition de son ancien président emblématique Carlo Molinari, décédé à l'âge de 93 ans. Une figure majeure de l'histoire grenat s'en va.

L'annonce de la disparition de Carlo Molinari a suscité une profonde émotion en Lorraine ainsi qu'au sein du football français. Sur ses réseaux sociaux, le FC Metz a immédiatement tenu à saluer la mémoire de son ancien dirigeant, qui a façonné l'identité du club au fil des décennies. Un choc immense pour la maison grenat.

L'ensemble des équipes du club s'est rassemblé pour rendre hommage à l'ancien président. « Le président Bernard Serin, les dirigeants, les joueurs, les entraîneurs, les anciens du club et l'ensemble des salariés du FC Metz adressent leurs plus sincères condoléances à sa famille et à ses proches. Merci Président Molinari, pour votre engagement, votre fidélité, votre humanité et tout ce que vous avez apporté au FC Metz. Votre histoire restera à jamais liée à celle des Grenats », a ainsi transmis le FC Metz dans son hommage officiel.

Carlo Molinari a dirigé le club mosellan pendant trente-quatre ans au total, au cours de deux mandats distincts : de 1967 à 1978, puis de 1983 à 2009. Fils d'immigré italien, cet ancien champion de France de cyclo-cross avait fait fortune dans une concession de poids lourds avant de succéder à Paul Mayer à la présidence du club lorrain en 1967. Sous sa gouvernance, la formation mosellane a garni son palmarès en remportant deux Coupes de France, en 1984 et en 1988, ainsi que deux Coupes de la Ligue, en 1986 et en 1996. Une longévité remarquable au plus haut niveau.

Au-delà de ces titres nationaux, le parcours du dirigeant reste gravé dans les mémoires grâce à l'exploit européen du 3 octobre 1984 en Coupe des vainqueurs de coupe. Battus à domicile au match aller (2-4), les Messins avaient renversé le FC Barcelone au Camp Nou en s'imposant largement (1-4) pour décrocher une qualification historique. D'ailleurs, les Lorrains ont aussi terminé à la deuxième place du championnat de Division 1 en 1998, échouant seulement à la différence de buts derrière le RC Lens.

Après avoir cédé les commandes du FC Metz à Bernard Serin avant de prendre du recul, Carlo Molinari avait d'abord occupé le rôle de vice-président tout en conservant une présence constante auprès de son club de cœur. Figure paternelle, il a notamment participé à l'éclosion d'internationaux français majeurs tels que Patrick Battiston et Robert Pirès. L'ancien dirigeant avait d'ailleurs assisté fin septembre 2026 au jubilé de Robert Pirès au stade Saint-Symphorien. Une fidélité absolue envers ses protégés.

En effet, le dirigeant entretenait une proximité très forte avec toutes les strates de l'institution. « Il connaissait l'importance de celles et ceux qui, dans l'ombre comme dans la lumière, contribuent chaque jour à faire vivre un club de football. Passionné, entier, parfois exigeant, mais toujours profondément attaché au FC Metz, il entretenait avec cette institution une relation qui dépassait largement le cadre de ses fonctions. Le club était pour lui une véritable famille », a détaillé le FC Metz au sujet de son ancien président. Actuellement dixième de Ligue 2, l'équipe messine disputera son prochain match le vendredi 6 novembre 2026 à 20h00 face au Montpellier HSC au Stade de la Mosson, dans le cadre de la 12e journée, et rendra certainement hommage à son légendaire président.

Cyriaque Irie and Keisuke Goto will target starting roles after their recent performances off the bench, while Vincenzo Grifo could also replace Derry Scherhant. Igor Matanović scored in back-to-back games after failing to get on the scoresheet in his previous nine appearances.

#2380. Mason Mount offering Michael Carrick a midfield solution which could have legs

It is not uncommon to hear football club executives talking about the importance of the “money being on the pitch”.

In other words, managers having their best players fit and available most if not all of the time. Quality at the top level is essential but so is robustness. They go hand in hand.

Unfortunately for Manchester United, the money has not been on the pitch down the years nearly as much as the club would want or expect.

Bruno Fernandes stands out for what he does with the ball primarily, but also because he plays almost every minute of every game and, while his sheer indefatigability is extreme, United know they need more of his ilk.

This is why the forthcoming season is such a big one for Mason Mount. His quality has seldom been in doubt. The problem is he has rarely been on the pitch long or consistently enough to show it.

Indeed, the one-time England midfielder has started just 25 Premier League matches since his £60m move from Chelsea three years ago and that perennial unavailability is one of the reasons doubts were being cast about his Old Trafford future going into this summer.

Yet Michael Carrick was keen to keep Mount, United have rebuffed inquiries around him and intriguingly the 27-year-old could yet have an impact on what the club do during the remaining six weeks of the transfer window.

For the second time in the space of six days, Mount was deployed in a deeper midfield role alongside new £48m, signing Andrey Santos for Friday’s resounding 5-0 victory over Norwegian side Rosenborg in Trondheim, just as he had done against Wrexham last weekend.

Mount has spent the majority of his career playing further forward, either off the right or as a No. 10 but Carrick likes him in a fluid No. 8 role, a position Erik ten Hag had identified for the player only for persistent injuries to detonate those plans.

The logic is simple: Mount is mobile, can cover the ground, is adept under pressure, has line breaking passing, vision and a nose for goal. He is also a good presence in the dressing room and a leader in his own way. Watch him imparting advice to Shea Lacey as they walked back to the centre circle after the youngster’s goal opened the scoring against Rosenborg and you get a glimpse of that.

The question, of course, is whether he can stay fit long enough to impose those qualities that help to explain why Liverpool and Arsenal had also been so keen to sign him back in 2023 and Carrick’s predecessor Ruben Amorim was also such a fan.

With United’s summer budget only stretching so far, Carrick was always going to have to think on his feet in certain areas of the pitch.

What will be interesting to see over the coming weeks is whether the manager feels Mount is robust enough to complement Santos, fellow summer signing Youri Tielemans and Kobbie Mainoo.

MASON MOUNT SCORES FOR MAN UNITED!He takes the ball with a quality turn, and curls it into the corner of the goal 🤩📺 @tntsports & @discoveryplusUK pic.twitter.com/M9ErA2HKbo

Much of the chatter among United fans at present centres on who the third midfield signing will be after Santos and Tielemans.

Given Mount’s injury record, it would be a significant risk not to recruit again in that department in the hope he could stay fit over a full season. Four options in two positions behind the No 10 of Fernandes sounds fine in principle but what happens if Mount’s season was to follow a similar trajectory to the previous three?

If United are going to strengthen in other areas, there will need to be compromises or alternative solutions that help to free up cash along the way but gambling in midfield may not be the best way to go.

With Champions League football to factor in this season, it is still hard to believe United will not seek to strengthen again in midfield but the club seem ready to take their time on that front. And all the while an assortment of names continue to fly around.

After spending £85m on Santos and Tielemans, a massive outlay on a third midfielder at this stage would be a bit of a surprise.

Could that negate a move for Real Madrid’s Aurelien Tchouameni? Alex Scott is greatly admired by United but Bournemouth are determined to keep him and have put a prohibitive pricetag on him.

AS Roma’s Manu Kone is not thought to have universal backing internally. Tyler Adams’ name has been floated again but the Bournemouth and US midfielder’s injury record counts against him.

There has not yet been evidence of a serious appetite to go for Brighton’s Carlos Baleba, whom they considered signing last summer. Sander Berge at Fulham and Borussia Dortmund’s Felix Nmecha are among a number of other midfielders who have been linked with United.

Another midfield signing could well emerge but United are keeping their cards close to their chest. Whatever materialises, though, it will still not change the fact this is a huge season for Mount.

⚽️ Shea Lacey⚽️ Jacob Devaney⚽️ Harry Amass⚽️ Ethan Williams Four #MUAcademy prospects were on the scoresheet in Trondheim 🧬💙 pic.twitter.com/fguQ36ANTM

“It was a good day. Clean sheet, scoring goals and everyone coming through injury-free hopefully is everything you want. Keeping the players fit and improving through pre-season is amongst the most important things. You want to build through the pre-season and you have to manage to players differently. It is never going to be perfect but we scored some great goals and we are moving forward nicely.

“I thought we defended well as a team for the most part. A clean sheet is a beautiful thing. I think we are in a good place with four weeks to go until the start, gradually getting some boys back from the World Cup. As it stands right now, we are in a pretty good place.”

This is what the official start of the season will look like for Michael Carrick’s side:

August 22- Hull vs Manchester UnitedAugust 30- Manchester United vs IpswichSeptember 6- Everton vs Manchester UnitedSeptember 13- Manchester United vs Manchester CitySeptember 20- Fulham vs Manchester United

They face two of the three promoted sides on the first two weekends and there is a very early Manchester derby.

August 1- Manchester United vs Atlético Madrid August 8- PSG vs Manchester United August 12- Manchester United vs Leeds August 15- AC Milan vs Manchester United

Having played Wrexham and Rosenborg in their first two games, the level of competition will rise significantly for Manchester United in the coming weeks.

There is the final whistle and Manchester United have cruised to a 5-0 win over Rosenborg in Norway. Goals from Lacey, Zirkzee, Devaney, Amass and Williams have seen Michael Carrick’s men ease to victory. A pretty one-sided game.

The first yellow card of the game is given very late on as Devaney is booked for a high boot.

A late change for Rosenborg as Hald-Hernes replaces Borgersen.

The visitors have dominated this game and they now have their fifth goal. It is created by great work from Kamason on the right side of the box before he squares it to Williams, who has the easiest of tap-ins at the far post.

Other than a few short periods in this game, Rosenborg have looked poor. They may be midway through their league season but you can see why they are down in 10th in the Norwegian top flight with just four wins from their opening 13 league games.

You would expect that Michael Carrick will be very keen to see his side keep a clean sheet.

Manchester United have their fourth of the evening. Kamason is found making an overlapping run on the right side of the box and his cross fired towards the back post is tapped in by Amass. That was a goal assisted by one full-back and scored by the other.

Good work from Soboczynski results in Rosenborg winning a corner out on the left. They take it short before a shot is hit from the edge of the box straight down the throat of Vitek.

Rosenborg hit the post. Manchester United should probably have been given a free-kick in the build-up as Soboczynski appeared to push Devaney over but play goes on. The ball comes to E Ceide at the far post but his effort strikes the outside of the post.

Just a few minutes after making a raft of changes, Manchester United have their third goal of the evening. Rosenborg fail to clear a corner from the right and the ball falls to Devaney on the six-yard box. He takes one touch before firing into the top of the net.

Bearing in mind Rosenborg are in the middle of their league season, this has been an encouraging showing so far from United. Joshua Zirkzee has been lively. He’s still more likely to leave than stay at Old Trafford this summer but performances like this won’t hamper his value. He set up Shea Lacey for his goal with a good pass after again dropping deep into space and he’s taken that goal to give United a 2-0 lead quite brilliantly. Patrick Dorgu has been a threat and Mason Mount has dovetailed well in central midfield with new signing Andrey Santos.

Both sides are going to make a raft of changes on the hour mark, with the rest of the Manchester United starting XI being changed other than Vitek in goal.

Santos brings down Borgersen not far outside the Manchester United penalty area to give Rosenborg a decent opportunity. It is a pretty decent effort from E Ceide that goes just wide of Vitek’s right post.

The visitors have not been great since the break but they have their second and it is a great solo goal from Zirkzee. Lacey, out on the left touchline, squares it for Zirkzee, who takes the ball towards the Rosenborg penalty area. He fakes a shot, which takes numerous Rosenborg defenders out of the equation as they slide past. He then sits down the Rosenborg keeper before slotting into an empty net. A fine goal from Zirkzee.

Soboczynski has his second chance since coming on at the break after good work from E Ceide down the left but the former’s effort goes wide.

That is a really poor decision from the linesman. Duris was played in behind the Manchester United defence and thought he was through for a one-on-one chance but the offside flag goes up. However, replays prove that Duris was clearly being played onside by Amass, who has looked shaky since coming on at the break.

Zirkzee receives a pass from Dorgu on the D and takes one touch before shooting. His effort takes a deflection and goes behind for a corner, which Wahlstedt slightly unconvincingly punches away.

That is a very good chance for Rosenborg to equalise early in this second half. Amass and Heaven makes a mess of things deep in their own half, presenting Rosenborg with a good opportunity inside the Manchester United penalty area. Two Rosenborg substitutes combine as Soboczynski squares it for Borgersen but the latter makes a mess of it and shoots well wide from 10 yards out.

Michael Carrick has decided to make just a few changes at the break with Amass and Kamason coming on. Shaw and Maguire have gone off, which has seen Yoro move inside from right-back to centre-back.

Our first goalscorer of pre-season = Shea Lacey! 💎 pic.twitter.com/AyFOWNh5Fi

With no delays, the first half is brought to an end and Manchester United take a 1-0 lead into the break courtesy of Lacey’s goal. Expect a raft of chnages at the break.

As this half has worn on, Manchester United’s dominance has only increased.

Mbeumo appeared to be racing through one-on-one but Mortensen just about gets back to outmuscle Mbeumo and allow the ball to go back to his keeper. There were a few appeals for a foul by Mortensen but that challenge was just about fine.

Other than those early stages, Manchester United have dominated the rest of this first half and are pressing for a second. For the second time in the half, they strike the frame of the goal. Mbeumo clips in a cross from the right into the Rosenborg penalty area and it picks out the head of Yoro. However, from eight yards out, the Frenchman’s header comes back off the bar.

Moments after they hit the frame of the goal, Michael Carrick’s side take the lead. Zirkzee picks up the ball inside his own half and, from the halfway line, feeds a pass into the on-running Lacey. Dorgu wants Lacey to play the ball across to him at the back post but the latter opts against it. Instead, just inside the Rosenborg penalty area, he cuts onto his preferred left foot and curls one into the far corner. A good finish from Lacey.

Just as I was saying that both sides were lacking a cutting edge in the final third, Manchester United are inches away from taking the lead as they strike the post. Santos feeds a delicate pass into the path of Dorgu on the left side of the box. Dorgu strikes his effort powerfully but it comes off the outside of the far post.

Both sides have lacked a cutting edge when they get into the opposition final third, hence why there has not been a plethora of good chances.

Mbeumo beats his man down Manchester United’s right and cuts it back to Mount on the edge of the Rosenborg penalty area. Mount hits it first time but his shot is blocked and spins behind for a corner. It is Manchester United’s first of the game but it is headed away.

That was nearly the moment for Rosenborg to take the lead. Pereira’s cross from the left-hand side of the box takes a deflection and nearly ends up at the feet of Chiakha at the back post but it is just out of his reach.

Rosenborg looked the sharper in the early exchanges but Manchester United are growing into the game and starting to gain more control.

Manchester United create their first opening of the game. Rosenborg poorly five the ball away deep inside their half and immediately Zirkzee plays it into the path of Mbeumo, whose shot from the right side of the box is saved by Rosenborg keeper Wahlstedt, who initially spilt the shot but gathered at the second attempt.

Mount trips Sahsah just outside the Manchester United penalty area, which will give Rosenborg a good shot to take an early lead. Rosenborg look a little sharper unsurprisingly in these early stages.

The Rosenborg captain Selnaes takes but hits it straight into the wall.

With Rosenborg in the midst of their season and Manchester United just in their second pre-season game, you would expect the hosts to have more rhythm and flow in their game.

Manchester United to appear to be lining up with a back four, with Yoro starting at right-back rather than his more customary centre-back position.

We are under way in Norway. Rosenborg are playing in white, with Manchester United in blue.

Both sides emerge from the tunnel, with Harry Maguire leading Manchester United out, and we are getting closer to kick-off in Norway.

Rosenborg: Wahlstedt, Mortensen, Singsdal Volden, Nemcik, Pereira; Bomholt, Selnaes, Fossum, Sunde, Chiakha, Sahsah.Substitutes: Sandberg, Amdam, M. Ceide, Rosten, Witry, Dahl, Hald-Hernes, Slordal, Hedman, Borgersen, Bakke, E. Ceide, Duris, Soboczynski.

Manchester United: Vitek; Yoro, Maguire, Heaven, Shaw; Santos, Mount; Lacey, Zirkzee, Dorgu; Mbeumo.Substitutes: Heaton, Mee, Amass, Armer, Kamason, Collyer, Devaney, J. Fletcher, T. Fletcher, Gore, Thwaites, Gabriel, Obi, Williams.

It’s a good opportunity for Shea Lacey tonight. He’s expected to be deployed in the hole in behind Joshua Zirkzee. A talented, highly technical footballer with a good left foot, he’ll be wanting to make the most of the chance. Another opportunity for Mason Mount to stake a claim in one of the two deeper midfield positions next to new signing Andrey Santos. Big season ahead for Mount.

OUTS:Casemiro ⇢ Inter Miami, FreeRasmus Hojlund ⇢ Napoli, £38mJadon Sancho, FreeTyrell Malacia, Free

Forward JJ Gabriel, who does not turn 16 until October, is on the bench for Manchester United this evening. The 15-year-old has represented England at U15, U16 and U17 level. He won the inaugural Premier League Under-18 Player of the Season award for the 2025/26 campaign.

Starting XI: Vitek; Yoro, Maguire (captain), Heaven, Shaw; Santos, Mount; Lacey, Zirkzee, Dorgu; Mbeumo.Substitutes: Heaton, Mee, Amass, Armer, Kamason, Collyer, Devaney, J.Fletcher, T.Fletcher, Gore, Thwaites, Gabriel, Obi, Williams.

Dagens 11 utvalgte 🖤🤍Avspark er klokken 18.00 🏟️ pic.twitter.com/LuZrojJM4l

Bring on United! 🫡Watch Rosenborg v United LIVE on MUTV, with build-up starting at 16:00 BST 📲

Manchester United’s preparations for the new season continue in Norway as they take on Rosenborg in their second pre-season game. These sides did meet in a pre-season friendly two years ago in July 2024, with Rosenborg winning that encounter 1-0.

Manchester United kicked off their pre-season against Wrexham nearly a week ago, which they lost 1-0 in Helsinki. Michael Carrick opted to deploy two different XIs for each half, meaning 22 players got a run-out. Manchester United kick off their Premier League campaign at newly promoted Hull City on August 22.

They have added two midfielders to their ranks over the last few weeks, both from the Premier League. Brazilian Andrey Santos has joined from Chelsea whilst Belgium’s Youri Tielemans has arrived from Aston Villa. Santos made his first Manchester United appearance in the loss to Wrexham whilst Tielemans is yet to feature having made the knockout stages with Belgium at the World Cup. A number of players are still yet to return from World Cup duty, including the likes of Lisandro Martinez, Marcus Rashford and Kobbie Mainoo, although Rashford still faces an uncertain future.

Former Leeds goalkeeper Karl Darlow has also arrived but he is currently recovering from a minor procedure. Benjamin Sesko is still trying to shake off a shin injury whilst Matthijs de Ligt is not yet available due to a back injury which plagued for most of last season. Manuel Ugarte faces a lengthy spell on the sidelines having picked up a serious injury whilst playing for Uruguay at the World Cup. After this game, the level of competition for Manchester United for the rest of pre-season ramps up a number of notches, with the likes of Atlético Madrid and back-to-back European champions PSG to come over the next couple of weeks as Carrick’s men prepare for a season in which they return to the Champions League.

Rosenborg are in the midst of their league campaign in Norway and are experiencing a tricky campaign. They are currently 10th in the Norwegian top flight, having won just four of their 13 league games thus far, but their form has picked up of late as they have won three of their last five games. They won their last match 3-0 against Start six days ago.

#2378. Lazio, tre punti sulla seconda: in Europa solo l’Arsenal tiene il passo

I Gunners precedono il Manchester City; negli altri tre campionati citati il distacco dalla seconda è di due punti.

La Lazio ha tre punti di vantaggio sulla seconda in classifica: nessuna capolista dei cinque maggiori campionati europei presenta un margine superiore. L’unica squadra che eguaglia i biancocelesti è l’Arsenal, anch’esso avanti di tre punti rispetto alla propria inseguitrice. Negli altri campionati presi in esame, il distacco tra prima e seconda è di due punti.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

Il dato riguarda il vantaggio della squadra al primo posto su quella immediatamente alle sue spalle. Sotto questo aspetto la Lazio condivide il margine più ampio tra le capoliste considerate: i suoi tre punti di vantaggio trovano un solo equivalente, quello dell’Arsenal. Barcellona, PSG e Dortmund guidano invece le rispettive classifiche con un punto di margine in meno rispetto ai biancocelesti.

Il riferimento è alle prime due posizioni nei cinque maggiori campionati europei. Per la Lazio il confronto mette quindi insieme il suo distacco sulla seconda e quelli registrati in Spagna, Francia, Germania e Inghilterra. Il primato dei biancocelesti è richiamato anche in un contenuto dedicato a Reja, che dichiara: «Vedere la Lazio prima mi riempie di gioia. Non deve porsi limiti».

In Spagna, secondo quanto riportato da Sportmediaset.mediaset.it,  il Barcellona è a più due sull’Atletico Madrid. La formazione che occupa la prima posizione precede dunque la seconda con un vantaggio inferiore di un punto a quello della Lazio. Il confronto tra le due capoliste mostra margini diversi: tre punti per i biancocelesti, due per il Barcellona.

La stessa distanza si registra in Francia, dove il PSG conserva due punti sul Lille. Anche in Bundesliga il Dortmund precede il Friburgo di due punti. Barcellona, PSG e Dortmund hanno così il medesimo vantaggio sulle rispettive inseguitrici, mentre la Lazio dispone di un punto in più di margine sulla seconda. Il quadro dei distacchi nei tre campionati è quindi uniforme: ciascuna delle loro capoliste è avanti di due punti.

#2375. Guimaraes will not force Newcastle exit like Isak, says Howe

Eddie Howe is confident Bruno Guimarães will not demand to leave Newcastle United for Arsenal and echo Alexander Isak’s acrimonious departure to Liverpool last summer.

Howe admitted he could not guarantee that Guimarães will still be at the club in September but gave a strong defence of his captain’s character and insisted the Brazil international will return for pre-season training next week as planned.

Given the huge gap between Newcastle’s valuation of Guimarães and what Arsenal have indicated they would be willing to pay for the 28-year-old, there is a belief on Tyneside that the only way the captain would join the London club is if he behaved as badly as Isak did 12 months ago.

Newcastle value Guimarães at £100m, while Arsenal, through intermediaries, have only indicated they would be willing to pay about £60m including bonuses.

Isak did not travel on the club’s pre-season tour to Asia and then went on strike, refusing to train or play, until Newcastle agreed to sell him to Liverpool for a British record £128m on deadline day.

Asked if he feared a repeat of that with Guimarães this time around, Howe replied: “I’ve spoken to him as I would do with Bruno normally. He is a fantastic person and we have had some really good conversations both before, during and after the World Cup. What we speak about obviously has to remain private but he is a great player and a great person.

“Look, I don’t know what is going to happen with Bruno. That is up to other people to speculate about but also other people to have conversations about which I’m not a part of. I don’t think it is fair to compare situations and what happened previously. You’ve got to look at this in its own right.

“Bruno is captain of our football club. He has been an unbelievable player and person all the time we have worked together. I speak on behalf of everyone at the football club when I say we absolutely love him and of course everyone wants him to stay.

“The plan is for him to come back on July 31, he gets an extended break because of the World Cup and is currently enjoying a holiday with his family... There is nothing to say that Bruno won’t be back training with us.”

"We've had some really good conversations" 🗣️Eddie Howe speaks on Newcastle's transfer window so far and speculation around Bruno Guimarães ⚫️⚪️ pic.twitter.com/zB1W31Fne0

Arsenal’s interest in Guimarães is well known but there has been little progress since they began their pursuit more than a month ago.

Whether Arsenal can come up with an offer that tempts Newcastle into negotiations remains to be seen but it is thought the Premier League champions will try to harden up their interest before Guimarães returns for pre-season training.

Newcastle United were held to a 1-1 draw by Gateshead in their second pre-season friendly of the summer. A 79th-minute own-goal saved the Premier League club’s blushes but what did we learn from the match?

Steur did not grab many headlines when he arrived from Ajax for £20m earlier this month because of Sandro Tonali’s move to Tottenham Hotspur. But those familiar with Dutch football would have been excited that Newcastle had signed him.

The 18-year-old has impressed with his performances in training and gave a glimpse of his significant potential in his first public display. He is young and sources have told Telegraph Sport that he must develop physically before he is ready to play every week in the Premier League – but you can already see he has a very high ceiling.

As you would expect from a player described as Ajax’s best midfield prospect for a generation, he is assured on the ball. He is also a progressive passer, always looking to break the lines to get his team moving forward. Eddie Howe will love him.

Whisper it, but there were shades of Bruno Guimarães in his style of play, in the way he took the ball under pressure, in tight spaces, and played on the turn. Patience will be needed but the signs are really encouraging.

Guimarães’s future is all supporters have wanted to speak about for weeks. I was at a wedding on Friday and it felt like everyone asked me about it at some point – including the bride and groom immediately after completing their first dance.

It has already become a summer-long transfer saga that has not progressed since Arsenal’s interest was revealed last month. Telegraph Sport has repeatedly checked whether there have been any fresh developments over the past week and the answer from senior Newcastle sources has remained consistent: there are no talks ongoing and nothing has accelerated, despite claims Arsenal were preparing an official £70m bid.

However, Newcastle need clarity from their captain. He is due back for pre-season next week and is expected to fly to Spain for their training camp on July 31. He has intimated he would like to move to Arsenal but unless Newcastle receive a bid that matches their asking price, he and his representatives have been told he will not be allowed to leave.

Schär has been a brilliant player for Newcastle, but at the age of 34 and coming off the back of a serious ankle injury, he looked understandably rusty against Gateshead.

This will be the former Switzerland international’s ninth season at St James’ Park and he was at fault for giving away a soft free-kick that led to Gateshead scoring first.

Schar accepted a contract extension earlier this summer on reduced terms and although Howe values his quality and experience, he is going to be a back-up centre-back this season.

Neave, 19, started the game as Newcastle’s centre-forward as Will Osula was missing and Nick Woltemade and Yoane Wissa were given additional time off after playing in the World Cup for Germany and DR Congo respectively.

But those players will return to training next week and, although Neave forced a good save in the first half, he is not ready to start in the Premier League. There is little point keeping him around as a fourth-choice striker when he needs to be playing regularly at this stage of his career.

A loan move is on the cards and he could be a really smart signing for a Championship club or a team competing at the top of League One. The most important thing is that he gets regular senior games rather than hangs around at Newcastle on the fringes of the first-team squad.

Eddie Howe has said "he does not know" what will happen with Bruno but pretty strong defence of his character and denied similarities with Isak. Said they have spoken regularly throughout the summer and he will be back for pre season training on July 31st #nufc

Eddie Howe’s side will head down to Ashton Gate before jetting off to La Manga for a training camp on July 31, which will feature many of those who played in the World Cup, including Bruno Guimarães who has been linked with a move to Arsenal.

In Spain, Newcastle will face Valencia at the Mestalla, before returning to the UK to play Everton at Murrayfield. They will then host Bayer Leverkusen and Strasbourg at St James’ Park for their final tune-up matches before the Premier League season starts.

Newcastle circulating the ball in front of Gateshead’s first line of pressure. The hosts regain possession but struggle to find a way through Newcastle’s midfield.

The officials and both sets of players line up behind a banner with the message ‘Rest in peace, Kevin Keegan’. Newcastle are in their new navy-blue away shirt, with Gateshead in their home white-and-black kit. A minute’s silence is then observed immaculately.

The tributes left in honour of Kevin Keegan outside St James’ Park is a sight to behold, with flowers, shirts and scarves covering the ground and steps in the south-west corner. It is a very moving thing to behold as people come to pay their respects to the Newcastle legend.

There will also be a minute’s silence before today’s game against Gateshead.

It has been a difficult and, at times, acrimonious 12 months for Eddie Howe, who must have wondered whether the job was still worth the hassle given the criticism and online vitriol he received at times last season.

Few would have blamed him if he had quit, but Howe has always been fully committed and always knew there would be a period like this to come through.

He has been in the job almost five years and last season was the first time he had been vilified by a section of the fanbase. It left its mark. The boos that followed defeats at St James’ Park hurt and he worried the unity that had powered the team’s success had fractured irreparably.

The apparent collective shrug that greeted another run to the Carabao Cup semi-final, while guiding the team into the knockout rounds of the Champions League for the first time was a source of bewilderment and frustration.

Howe has not complained or moaned. Although he wobbled towards the end of last season and there were some calling for him to be sacked, he was supported and encouraged by those above him. That loyalty mattered.

The problem is, negativity lingers in the fanbase. Even a picture of Howe at pre-season training, posted on social media by the club, led to abusive comments questioning his ability and character. Some of it was toxic. It was rightly called out by other supporters.

Goals from Elliot Anderson (wonder what happened to him?!), Allan Saint-Maximin and Jay Turner-Cooke helped Newcastle overturn a 2-0 half-time deficit when they last visited Gateshead International Stadium in 2023.

Speaking through Gateshead’s club media, Cattermole said of facing Newcastle: “It’s obviously a different test. We have to respect the opposition, they’re a high-quality team and it might not be what we’re getting in our league but we’ll still try to implement what we believe we want to be in and out of possession. It’ll be a great physical challenge for us.

He added: “They [my players] have all shown up great. What a game for them. What a game for them to go and test yourself against some big names and fantastic coaching staff, for us all it’s a great challenge for us. We hope we give them a good test, we hope we give them the challenge they want as well. I played in many of these games as a player as well. We expect it to be competitive.”

A classic first-game-of-pre-season vibe to Newcastle’s team sheet as established stars rub shoulders with youngsters from the academy.

Only one of their four summer signings, former Ajax midfielder Sean Steur, starts the game and there will be a lot of interest in the 18-year-old. The youngster has impressed in training over the last couple of weeks but it is thought he has a lot of work to do physically to be ready for the Premier League.

Full-back Leo Shahar was in and around the first team last season as was striker Sean Neave. Alex Murphy, who started one game in the Champions League last season is expected to go out on loan before the window shuts, but starts alongside Fabian Schar in the centre of defence.

Worryingly there is no sign of Sven Botman and Will Osula who both played in the behind-closed-doors friendly against Darlington last weekend.

Joelinton, Tino Livramento and Lewis Miley are still being eased back into things after injuries at the end of last season.

Another new signing, goalkeeper Ewen Jaouen, is on the bench and will play the second half against their National League neighbours.

Gateshead lost manager Rob Elliot to Carlisle at the end of last season and are now managed by former Sunderland and Middlesbrough midfielder Lee Cattermole.

Fabian Schär returns from an ankle injury that has sidelined him since January, but only one of Newcastle’s four summer signings (Sean Steur) starts.

Welcome to live coverage of Newcastle United’s pre-season friendly against North-East neighbours Gateshead. Eddie Howe’s side make the three-mile journey south of the River Tyne having beaten Darlington 3-0 in their first outing of the summer last weekend. The Magpies’ National League opponents this afternoon, helmed by former Sunderland captain Lee Cattermole, have already played three times in pre-season, thrashing Blyth 6-0 and drawing against Heaton Stannington and Hebburn Town. The Heed threatened a shock win in their last meeting with Newcastle three summers’ ago, leading 2-0 at the interval before conceding three second-half goals.

This contest at Gateshead International Stadium will be Newcastle’s first match since the death of Kevin Keegan and the club have confirmed that a minute of silence will be observed before kick-off. Newcastle’s men’s, women’s and academy teams will wear black armbands for all pre-season matches this summer.

Newcastle United's men's, women's and Under-21s teams will wear black armbands across all pre-season matches this summer as the club honours the life of Kevin Keegan.Full details ⤵️

Newcastle will welcome Liverpool, with whom Keegan enjoyed success in the 1970s, to St James’ Park for their Premier League opener, and the two sides are in talks over a suitable pre-match tribute. Flowers, messages and mementos have been laid outside Newcastle’s ground since Keegan’s death on Monday, including a heartfelt message penned by fellow club legend Alan Shearer, which read: “I hope you realised how much you meant, to me, to this club, to everyone. Thank you does not seem enough. Rest In Peace Boss. Alan Shearer.”

With regards to the football, there is an acceptance among Newcastle supporters that, having finished 12th in the Premier League last season and lost Anthony Gordon, Kieran Trippier and Sandro Tonali, this is a summer of transition. The uncertainty surrounding the future of £100m-rated club captain Bruno Guimarães, who is on the radar of Arsenal, will be a concern; Newcastle will be keen to avoid a repeat of the furore that circled Alexander Isak’s departure last summer. Guimarães will join the team next week following his World Cup exploits with Brazil and is expected to take part in Newcastle’s La Manga training camp, which starts on July 31.

Summer signings Sean Steur and Ewen Jaouen were each handed 45 minutes in the behind-closed-doors victory over Darlington, during which Howe used different XIs for the two halves. Bazoumana Touré – the £50m winger acquired from Hoffenheim – is expected to feature today having returned from his post-World Cup holiday. Yesterday Newcastle announced the arrival of midfielder Aladji Bamba, the France youth international, from Monaco and he was immediately integrated into team training. There is every possibility that he will feature this afternoon. Gateshead this week announced two signings of their own, as Luke Supyk, the New Zealand Under-20 forward, agreed a two-year deal having scored three goals in pre-season as a trialist. Defender Jack Robinson also joined the club.

#2374. Giordano: “Abbiamo preso un gol da polli, ma la reazione è stata forte”

Bruno Giordano esalta il carattere della Lazio, il trascinatore Isaksen e i cambi.

La Lazio si gode il primato in classifica e Bruno Giordano intervenuto ai microfoni di Radiosei, analizza questo momento d'oro biancoceleste. Secondo l'ex bomber, la squadra sa vincere e soffrire grazie alla crescita della personalità  di Isaksen. Nonostante la stanchezza e i problemi tattici, la maturità mentale e i cambi azzeccati di Gattuso fanno la differenza.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

Vittoria meritata. Non si può pretendere di giocare sempre come a Torino o a Reggio Emilia. La partita si era messa male, abbiamo preso un gol da polli, ma la reazione è stata forte; la squadra si è aggrappata ad Isaksen, che in questo momento sta trascinando il gruppo. Squadra un po' stanca che appunto si è aggrappata a lui, va sfruttato il suo momento. Il risultato assume anche più valore in questi casi, quando non tutto va al 100%.  Isaksen sta crescendo anche in personalità. Sotto l'aspetto del gioco non mi meraviglia, lo abbiamo visto in Europa contro di noi, i suoi colpi li ha. Ora sta prendendo sicurezza, i compagni lo cercano e questo lui lo avverte e gli dà tranquillità. Il gol di ieri è difficile e bellissimo, lui spesso li fa belli; mi ricordo poche reti sue brutte. Il modo di giocare e la fiducia del tecnico stanno facendo la differenza. Ho sempre detto che non sapeva gestire i 90', faceva mezz'ora bene poi calava, ora invece arriva alla fine come se fosse il 70' e questo è un valore aggiunto.

Taylor è un giocatore dinamico, tecnico, completo. L'uscita di Fadera è stata un bene per noi, ci stava mettendo in difficoltà; è stato un vantaggio che abbiamo saputo sfruttare.  Serve la maturità per capire che non tutte le partite posso andare allo stesso modo, c'è stata pazienza ieri e non è facile perché a volte ti puoi innervosire. La Lazio mi ha dato l'impressione che sta maturando anche sotto questo suo aspetto, ha la consapevolezza che anche se va in svantaggio può poi vincere.  I cambi della Lazio? Si vedeva che alcuni calciatori, soprattutto quelli sostituiti, erano stanchi. L'allenatore deve fare delle scelte e mettere a disposizione i migliori del momento. Tavares era un po' affaticato rispetto alle gare precedenti, Frattesi giocava troppo vicino ai difensori centrali del Cagliari e così mancava qualcosa in mezzo al campo. Ci può stare, rientra tutto nella logica delle cose.

#2372. Pioli: “Ci sono stati momenti in cui mi hanno chiamato tutti. Anche la Roma”

L’ex allenatore della Fiorentina racconta del motivo per cui andò ad allenare l’Al Nassr e di quando fu chiamato dalla Roma e dalla Nazionale

Stefano Pioli ex allenatore biancoceleste ha legato una delle pagine più esaltanti della sua carriera proprio alla panchina della Lazio, condotta nel 2014-2015 a uno straordinario terzo posto e a una finale di Coppa Italia persa contro la Juve. L’apice della sua carriera il tecnico lo  ha raggiunto con lo storico scudetto vinto alla guida del Milan nel 2022. Il tecnico è stato  intervistato per Sky Sport, raccontando di quando fu vicino alla Roma e alla Nazionale.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

Ci sono stati momenti in cui mi hanno chiamato tutti. Anche la Roma, ma mi era appena arrivato il contratto dell’Al Nassr, ma non mi sono pentito di andare in Arabia. Volevo un’esperienza fuori. Hanno inciso l’aspetto economico e la possibilità di allenare Cristiano Ronaldo. Anche la panchina della Nazionale l’ho sfiorata e non da moltissimo.

Nell’estate del 2025 Pioli torna a Firenze dopo esserci stato sia da allenatore tra 1989-95 che da allenatore tra il 2017-19. Purtroppo per il tecnico la sua seconda esperienza nella Fiorentina si è rivelata estremamente negativa: nelle prime 10 partite di campionato la squadra non ha mai vinto, raccogliendo appena 4 pareggi, subendo 6 sconfitte e totalizzando solo 4 punti. Un avvio da record negativo che ha portato inevitabilmente all'esonero il 4 novembre 2025.
